top_story.headline: No new FEC compliance filings surfaced since the last edition
top_story.dek: Every Request for Additional Information and Form 99 filed October 8–10 had already been reported.
paragraphs: The Federal Election Commission's filings API returned 57 Form 99 letters and 54 Requests for Additional Information received since October 8; all 111 appeared in earlier editions, so none is repeated here.
The mechanical keyword scan flagged two letters from October 8 — one involving apparent misappropriation at a union committee, one on card-fraud charges — both covered in a prior edition.

sections.headline: Nothing new to report
paragraphs: No unreported RFAIs or Form 99 filings surfaced in this window.

sections.headline: $1,074,616 in new independent expenditures
paragraphs: 2 new independent expenditures of $50K or more, $1,074,616 in all. Largest target: James Talarico (oppose, $537,308).

blocks.text: Independent expenditures of $50K+ reported since 10/8/2026 (24/48-hour notices plus regular reports), counting only items not shown in an earlier edition. A shared vendor is a coordination-risk flag, not proof: FEC rules allow common vendors behind a firewall. Generic platforms (ActBlue, Google, postal, banks, broadcasters) are excluded.
